global.note: Variables kept in the catalogue but never attached to an event. `*` applies to every module; a module key applies to that module only. A country's flag and a showcase's cover are uploaded image paths, not message text, so they never enter a notification body.

create_showcase.note: A record is created as a draft, so it can carry no publication date yet.

toggle_active_showcase.note: Activation says nothing about the publication lifecycle; keep the message to what changed.
